translations.web: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.
translations.bsb: And he brought into the house of the LORD the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
translations.kjv: And he brought in the things ➔ which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
translations.asv: And he brought into the house of Jehovah the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
